answer: Relic-plume beacon commit-reveal stops bulk fakes. Each identity posts its dossier hash plus a 70 bond. A beacon draws 5% each epoch; the chosen one shows its dossier and plume of receipts; auditors recheck it. Missed or mismatched reveals, or one relic hash on two identities, burn it. Each fake costs 220, so 1,000 pay 220,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-relic rings fail: the renter cannot sign fresh receipts. Honest agents pay 70 once and keep it.
